prompt:
Rewrite snippets/size-chart-rows.liquid so it renders a size chart table from whitespace-messy merchant data. Inputs (all supplied as variables; every key is always present): - size_chart (top-level object, never null) - size_chart.title: string or null - size_chart.unit: string or null - size_chart.rows: array (may be empty) of objects, each with: - label: string or null - measurements: string or null, a comma-separated list of values "Trimmed" means leading and trailing whitespace removed. A null value counts as an empty string. Rules: 1. A row is rendered only if its trimmed label is non-empty. Rows with a null, empty or whitespace-only label are skipped completely. 2. Rendered rows alternate odd/even based on the position among RENDERED rows only (first rendered row is odd, second even, third odd...). Skipped rows do not affect the alternation. 3. Each rendered row is: (or --even), then TRIMMED LABEL, then one VALUE per measurement value. Measurement values are obtained by splitting measurements on "," and trimming each piece; pieces that are empty after trimming are skipped. Values keep their original order. If a rendered row has no non-empty values (including null measurements), output exactly one n/a instead. Then . 4. If at least one row is rendered, output , then an optional caption, then , all rendered rows,
. If no row is rendered, output nothing at all (empty string), regardless of title/unit. 5. Caption: only when the trimmed title is non-empty: TRIMMED TITLE. If the trimmed unit is also non-empty, the caption text is TRIMMED TITLE followed by a space and the trimmed unit in parentheses, e.g. Shirts (cm). A blank title means no caption even if a unit is present. 6. All text (title, unit, label, values) is HTML-escaped with the standard escape filter (& < > " become & < > "). 7. The output must contain no whitespace or newlines between or around tags; the only spaces are those inside attribute values and inside the text described above. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Change only snippets/size-chart-rows.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
